rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXXII Of the number of Wives
rules.meaning_historical_only: A separate numbered chapter begins lower original PDF624, after marriage ease and timing chapter.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: all Significators of Marriage be in watry Signes
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly starts from all indicators occupying watery signs rather than merely one watery placement.
The author treats watery signs as traditionally fruitful, not evidence of reproductive physiology.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: for the most part note many Wives
rules.meaning_historical_only: The text alleges a plural wife count from this condition, without real marital registers.
The author explicitly permits an indefinite multiple outcome instead of a specified number.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: contrary if posited in Virgo Leo Gemini
rules.meaning_historical_only: The source names Virgo, Leo and Gemini as barren contrast to watery signs for the wife-count method.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and Venus give most evident testimony
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly explicitly prioritizes Moon/Venus in men’s wife-count method over other marriage factors.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in seventh in what Signe soever
rules.meaning_historical_only: A lunar seventh-house placement is asserted to predict multiple partners independent of Moon's zodiac sign.
The author alleges plural wife count from Moon-seventh placement, unsupported by marriage data.
An unusually severe Saturn contact is expressly an exception to the Moon-seventh multiple-wives case.
A severe solar affliction is an alternative exception alongside Saturn, not always both.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: I never knew Native failed plurality of She-friends
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author claims no remembered failures in women-friend count without enumerated cases or controls.
The self-report admits nonmarital concubines as outcome when not two legal wives; this changes the target.
Lilly expressly admits the Moon-seventh rule did not consistently predict two legal spouses.
A fortified Moon is a further modifier used to rescue the plural legal-wife count.
The source alleges more than one legal wife under the strengthened-Moon version, not verified.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon conjoyned to one Planet onely
rules.meaning_historical_only: Moon conjoined to exactly one planetary companion is the precondition of the one-wife branch.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: whether by platick or partill aspect
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author allows both wider-orb and exact conjunction/aspect categories, without explicit numeric orb sizes.
A sole spouse is the asserted outcome, conflicting with flexible Moon-seventh multiple claims in some charts.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon more strong then that Planet
rules.meaning_historical_only: Relative lunar strength versus aspecting companion is used for a separate mortality prediction.
The source claims husband lives longer if Moon is stronger, not independent survival evidence.
Reverse planetary-strength ranking forms the opposite death-order source case.
The source claims husband dies first in reverse condition, unsupported by observed couple follow-ups.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon bodily joyned to no Planet
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author introduces a different counting method only if Moon has no bodily conjunction.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: how many Planets ... aspect her partilly
rules.meaning_historical_only: The number of qualifying partile aspecting planets is proposed to equal spouse count.
Direct planetary motion is a condition on counted planets.
Combustion of candidate planet excludes it from this branch.
Candidates in the traditional fall dignity are excluded.
Detriment is another source-defined dignity exclusion.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon apply to them not they unto her
rules.meaning_historical_only: The direction of application matters, an explicit negative for reverse application.
The author excludes Sun from the counted planets in this method, not globally.
The original proposes doubling eligible spouse counts when qualifying aspect planets occupy fruitful signs.
Lilly explicitly attributes the next method to Ptolemy; the original Ptolemy source has not yet been cross-verified.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in a Signe of one forme
rules.meaning_historical_only: A sign classified as one-form is a precondition for the alleged sole-wife Ptolemaic rule.
The one-form rule additionally requires Moon applying to exactly one planet.
Lilly's Ptolemy-attributed method predicts one wife from that combination, without empirical cases.
A dual-bodied zodiac sign is proposed as an alternative Ptolemaic condition.
The bicorporeal case further requires lunar application to multiple planets.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: many Wives or Marriage oftener then once
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author permits either simultaneous/number or repeated legal marriage as a flexible outcome.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: If no such thing appeare as formerly mentioned
rules.meaning_historical_only: The Midheaven-Venus method is a fallback after other methods yield no usable configuration.
The method counts a candidate planet only when direct in motion.
Qualifying planets must also avoid combustion in the ordinary form.
Sun beams are also named as disqualifying proximity.
The original location constraint counts planets lying in a specified Midheaven-to-Venus arc.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: making progresse from mid-heaven towards ascendant
rules.meaning_historical_only: Counting direction from MC towards Ascendant is explicit and cannot be reversed arbitrarily.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: so many Wives shall Native have
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author proposes one wife per qualifying planetary count, not an independently verified result.
The source admits retrograde planets as an exception to the ordinary direct-only fallback rule.
Combust candidates are similarly allowed under additional historic dignity criteria.
A candidate in its own domicile can be restored to eligibility despite retrograde or combust state.
Exaltation is the corresponding alternative essential dignity for exception.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: or mutual Reception of such dignities
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mutual reception of domicile/exaltation can also restore candidate eligibility.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: account those Planets in number for Wives
rules.meaning_historical_only: The rule explicitly reintroduces previously excluded candidates into the spouse-number count.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: When these rules hold not or use cannot be made
rules.meaning_historical_only: A further fallback method is provided when earlier count schemes cannot be applied.
The object to receive candidate aspects is the ruler of the seventh house.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: behold Lord seventh with partill aspect
rules.meaning_historical_only: Exactness of candidate planetary aspects is required, not any broad conjunction.
Retrograde condition does not disqualify planets in this fallback method.
Combustion also does not disqualify candidate planets under this particular fallback.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: from thence collect number of Wives
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author proposes count by all these eligible aspects rather than Moon sign placement.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: best approved rule I have hitherto found by experience
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly describes preferred personal experience without audited successes, denominators or negative cases.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: how many Planets there are in Signe Moon is in
rules.meaning_historical_only: The preferred source counts other planets physically in the Moon's same zodiac sign.
Lunar application to companions is required for the preferred first variant.
Already separating contacts are explicitly excluded from this variant.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: so many Wives Native may expect
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author maps same-sign applying candidates directly to alleged wife count.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if no such bodily presence be
rules.meaning_historical_only: A secondary branch applies when Moon has no qualifying bodily contact in her sign.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Planets having dignities in Signe she is in
rules.meaning_historical_only: Alternative candidates must hold essential dignity in Moon's sign.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: doe behold her with partill aspect
rules.meaning_historical_only: Those dignity-qualified candidates also must aspect Moon partile, not just occupy a related sign.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: so many Wives may be hoped for
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly concludes the alternative partile/dignity count, without independent outcome verification.
A weak marriage-significator condition changes what is inferred from the proposed wife-count rules.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: they argue Sweet hearts and Wenches
rules.meaning_historical_only: The source treats nonlegal relationships as outcome when wife count fails, an explicit target switch.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: may woo for Wives rather then marriage itself
rules.meaning_historical_only: Attempting to obtain marriage is distinct from actually marrying, another rescue category.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon apply to a Planet in common Signe
rules.meaning_historical_only: One purported two-wife case requires Moon applying to a planet located in a common sign.
The common-sign source branch asserts exactly two wives, without marriage documents.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: apply Planet in fruitful or Bycorporeall Signes
rules.meaning_historical_only: The Moon must apply to a planet in another fruitful or bicorporeal sign.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord seventh in common or fruitfull Signe
rules.meaning_historical_only: The seventh ruler must also be in a common/fruitful sign for the stronger version.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: without dispute Native will have three Wives
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly states certainty for the compound three-wife branch despite no independent confirmation.
